name: Park Hyatt Ningbo Resort & Spa
positioning: Lakeside resort on the banks of Dongqian Lake in Ningbo, designed around the idea of modern people living in a village
best_for: Weekend escapes from Shanghai to a lake setting
Travelers interested in Chinese architecture, tea culture and regional seafood

facts.text: The resort sits on the banks of Dongqian Lake in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province.
The resort's design follows the concept of modern people living in a village.
Each room has floor-to-ceiling views of the lake or the mountains.
Village Area rooms are in two-story or single-story buildings with Chinese-style residential elements.
There is a temperature-controlled indoor pool in traditional Chinese architecture and an outdoor infinity pool with lake views.
Yue Hu Spa offers treatments from facials to stone therapy.
Seafood House is set along the canal with an outdoor garden and courtyard.
On weekends, Dining Room serves a lake-view brunch featuring lobster prepared in a variety of ways.
Red hosts the resort's vegetarian temple food feast.
The Tea House hosts Kunqu performances.
Dogs are welcome and are housed in garden-view rooms.
Guests can cycle around Dongqian Lake and explore its temples.

highlights.text: The resort's dining boat cruises Dongqian Lake with mountain views while guests dine.
Red, the resort's bar, was rebuilt from a 700-year-old classical temple palace.
Spa Suites include a Chinese-style courtyard with an outdoor whirlpool, steam room and sauna.
At Seafood House, guests choose their own catch and a preparation style, from Ningbo favourites to Zhejiang flavours.
On weekend evenings the Tea House becomes a Chinese bistro.

considerations.text: The resort is about two and a half hours' drive from Shanghai.
Ningbo Lishe International Airport is 21.4 kilometers from the hotel.
